PLAN "12-Week bone-loading resistance program for advanced female lifter with heat intolerance"

TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Bone-loading resistance program with heat-tolerant strategy"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Phase 1 - Week 1":
        warmup:
          walking 10 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x6 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          bench_press 4x6 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          barbell_row 4x6 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 4x6 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Phase 1 - Week 1":
        warmup:
          rowing 6 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 4x5 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          overhead_press 3x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Friday training 60m "Phase 1 - Week 1":
        warmup:
          cycling 8 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          incline_press 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 60 seconds
  PHASE "Phase 2" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Monday training 65m "Phase 2 - Week 5":
        warmup:
          walking 12 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 5x5 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          bench_press 5x5 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          barbell_row 5x5 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          hip_thrust 4x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Phase 2 - Week 5":
        warmup:
          row 8 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 4x6 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          overhead_press 4x6 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 4x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          thoracic_m mobility 60 seconds
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Friday training 65m "Phase 2 - Week 5":
        warmup:
          cycling 10 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          sumo_deadlift 4x5 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          incline_press 4x6 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          cable_row 4x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 4x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 60 seconds
  PHASE "Phase 3" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Monday training 70m "Phase 3 - Week 9":
        warmup:
          walking 12 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x5 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          bench_press 4x5 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          barbell_row 4x5 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          hip_thrust 4x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          lower_back_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Wednesday training 55m "Phase 3 - Week 9":
        warmup:
          rowing 8 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 5x5 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          military_press 4x6 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 4x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Friday training 70m "Phase 3 - Week 9":
        warmup:
          cycling 10 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          sumo_deadlift 4x5 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          incline_press 4x6 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          cable_row 4x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 4x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_rom 60 seconds
  PHASE "Phase 4" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 13:
      DAY Monday training 75m "Phase 4 - Week 13":
        warmup:
          walking 12 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 5x5 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          bench_press 5x5 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          barbell_row 5x5 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          hip_thrust 5x6 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 13:
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Phase 4 - Week 13":
        warmup:
          row 8 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 5x5 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          overhead_press 5x5 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 5x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          thoracic_mobility 60 seconds
    WEEK 13:
      DAY Friday training 75m "Phase 4 - Week 13":
        warmup:
          cycling 12 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          sumo_deadlift 5x5 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          incline_press 5x6 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          cable_row 5x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 5x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 60 seconds

SYNTAX RULES:
- Rep ranges use two dots: 8..12
- Sets always come first: 4x6
- RPE after sets/reps: rpe 7
- Rest in seconds: rest 90 seconds

EXERCISE VOCABULARY used:
push_up, pull_up, chin_up, dip, bench_press, incline_press, decline_press, dumbbell_press, shoulder_press, overhead_press, military_press, arnold_press, dumbbell_row, barbell_row, bent_over_row, jumping_jack, jump_rope, high_knees, butt_kicks, burpee, squat_jump, tuck_jump, arm_circles, leg_swings, hip_circles, ankle_circles, jog_in_place, marching, jumping_lunge, box_step, skater_jump, turkish_getup, clean, clean_and_press, snatch, kettlebell_swing, thrusters, wall_ball, farmers_walk, suitcase_carry, battle_ropes, rowing, scapular_retraction, external_rotation, internal_rotation, prone_T, prone_Y, prone_W, pelvic_tilt, diaphragmatic_breathing

CARDIO MODALITIES:
running, cycling, swimming, rowing, elliptical, jump_rope, walking, hiking

Notes:
- This program prioritizes bone-loading compound lifts with progressive overload.
- Heat-management: sessions include longer cooldowns and cooling-focused recovery cues as needed; avoid sauna-like environments and fasted high-intensity in heated spaces.
- If a client experiences excessive heat symptoms, decrease session intensity by 1 RPE step and extend cooldown by 5–10 minutes, focusing on cooling down and hydration.
